Chapter 563: Chapter 12: Hang in There, I’ll Go Through the Shuttle (Subscribe Please)_3

“I’ve already contacted many friends, and among the human Evolvers entering the Secret Realm this time, there are two who can hold up against Hunyi.”

“It’s just that these two are incredibly far away from us; it is estimated that it would take twenty to thirty years to get here.”

Xilan said softly.

The Tianyu Clan had a Ninth Rank special being like Hunyi who had opened up over thirty million Spatial Layers; naturally, human civilization also had Ninth Rank powerhouses of the same level.

It was just that the distance was too great, and in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, where teleportation could not be used, the time required to get here was too lengthy.

Twenty to thirty years?

...

His Avatar would probably have almost condensed by then.

“Brother Xilan, if it’s just you, how long can you hold out against Hunyi’s pursuit?” Lin Yuan suddenly asked.

“How long can I hold out?”

Xilan was slightly taken aback.

Even in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, facing the terrifying pursuit of a being like Hunyi, a Ninth Rank below the Million Heavy Realm could consider it rare to last several days.

But Xilan was different; he was very good at escaping, excelling in jumping through the multiple Spatial Layers. Xilan was confident he could last even longer.

But what’s the point of that?

No matter how long he could hold out, it wouldn’t exceed twenty to thirty years.

In the end, he would still die at the hands of Hunyi.

Instead of that, why not expose himself proactively and recondense his Avatar to re-enter.

“I have an elder who needs only three years to get here and save us,” Lin Yuan thought for a bit, then made up an excuse.

“An elder?”

“Three years?”

Xilan’s eyes brightened.

He did not doubt the truth of what Lin Yuan said; as the strongest genius in the history of human civilization, having a powerful elder was nothing strange.

“In three years, if I burn everything of this Avatar, including my Spirit Will, I am confident I can hold out.”

After thinking for a while, Xilan said earnestly.

This depended on the special environment of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and the areas in which his Evolution Path excelled.

If it were the outside world, let alone three years, he wouldn’t last three seconds.

“Are you certain your elder will arrive within three years?”

Xilan asked again, nervously.

Burning his Avatar was nothing much for him, but burning his Spirit Will—that was a huge price that would affect his True Body.

Of course, the strength he would obtain from that sacrifice was terrifying enough to keep Xilan alive under Hunyi’s pursuit for three years.

Xilan was confident he could hold out, but he feared that Lin Yuan’s elder wouldn’t make it in three years.

By then, not only would he have burned his Spirit Will, but the Treasures carried by his Avatar would also be lost. Would that not be a huge loss?

“Don’t worry,”

“Three years is more than enough.”

Lin Yuan continued, “Take me into your Inner World, and I will contact that elder of mine.”

“Okay.”

Xilan nodded.

In the same moment, Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared.

Inner World.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in a corner.

“Three years…”

“At the rate of time flow during this traversal, at most two and a half years would have passed in the Main World,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

He had told Xilan an elder would come to the rescue within ‘three years’, which naturally wasn’t the truth.

In reality, Lin Yuan intended to use these three years for his ninth traversal.

From the coordinates of the World Mark he had newly obtained, Lin Yuan had already gotten some information beforehand, including the time flow rate in both worlds and the duration he could stay after completing the traversal.

With a little calculation, he could figure out how much time would pass in the Main World during his complete ninth traversal.

“Brother Xilan…”

“You just hold on for a bit longer…”

Lin Yuan slowly closed his eyes, and the Door to the Myriad Realms in his mind began to shine with light.
